decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-3 prefetch/overlap with alternating train/eval coordinators - each coordinator must consume only its own in-flight allgather handles (no shared InflightParamRegistry)
decisions.note: Param allgather-before-forward-read is T10's core hazard pair; the shared handle registry is a precondition guard.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: PP>1; precondition: PP loss-aggregation broadcast receive buffer must carry the sender's loss dtype
decisions.note: Collective receive buffer dtype at use point is a designated-dtype site under T05's predicate.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: hybrid GatedDeltaNet mixer params (A_log/dt_bias) must receive GDN-prescribed init; generic InitMethod must delegate to the mixer
decisions.note: Uninitialized/empty init-time parameter memory is directly covered by T27's uninitialized-memory clause.
Promoted with batch-02 singleton OC-NEW-30 (independent incident): same boundedness operator over router gate/combine probability values, one range predicate covers both (§4).

decisions.guard_extension: topology: FSDP; precondition: FSDP meta-device init on torch>=2.1 must apply reset_parameters after materialization
decisions.note: Default/zero-filled params in place of the designed init violate T27's init-statistics predicate.
Cross-job atomic/consistent cache-artifact integrity; operator (structural_integrity) differs from T10's happens-before (§3.1), objects from D-041/O-001 (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO gradient allreduce bucket must honor configured communication_data_type (no hard-coded fp16 downcast of bf16 grads)
decisions.note: Gradient communication dtype is a designated-dtype use point under T05.
Disjoint+complete leftover-index partition across workers; exclusivity objects differ from T19/T20 and exclusivity singletons (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: dataset cached loss mask returned by reference - per-sample in-place padding must mutate a private copy, never the shared cache
decisions.note: Non-designated writer mutating shared cached state is T23's core relation.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: DP>1 and PP>1; phase: data_loading; precondition: batch broadcast src must be the true first global rank of the DP group under non-contiguous layouts
decisions.note: The broadcast training batch is replicated state whose checksum must agree across the replication group.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: multi-bucket grad buffers - 1/dp_size must divide each bucket's own span exactly once, not the whole buffer per bucket
decisions.note: Cumulative (1/dp_size)^num_buckets is an exactly-once scale-factor violation under T08.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: q_norm and k_norm elementwise_affine must both equal the configured attention_layer_norm_with_affine
decisions.note: structural_integrity re-resolved to config_effectiveness from the relation statement (batch-01/02 precedent): constructed flag must equal configured value.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: muP resume must not re-apply set_base_shapes rescaling to already-muP-scaled restored parameters (idempotent load)
decisions.note: Post-load parameters must equal saved values; the double rescale is a load-path precondition guard.

decisions.guard_extension: phase: backward; precondition: fine-grained backward_dw scheduling must invoke every trainable submodule's weight-grad computation (incl. latent MoE projections) exactly once per backward pass
decisions.note: A per-boundary required launch occurring zero times fits T26's exactly-once event counting (cf. param_sync launches).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: keep-in-bf16 exempt layers must stay excluded from FP8/FP4 cast paths, including under CUDA-graph capture with global low-precision enabled
decisions.note: Pinned module compute dtype is a designated-dtype use point under T05.
Tokens entering each expert must equal tokens_per_expert (no padding on non-quantized paths); count objects differ from T12/T21/T26 and count singletons (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: SwiGLU-configured FFN must compute the gated reference silu(w1(h)) * w3(h); the gating branch must not be dropped
decisions.note: implementation_equivalence normalizes to reference_equivalence via the alias map; witness is an external reference computation (T04, not T03).

Retention must evict oldest and never the just-saved newest; value-ordering over the retention set, not a happens-before race (§3.2), and merging with D-022's sort order needs unrelated OR branches (§3.3).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: CUDA-graph capture combined with activation recompute of the same module - replay must match the eager reference
decisions.note: invariance_across_config normalizes to reference_equivalence; CUDA-graph replay vs eager is a performance-only config pair (T03's paired-run witness).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ratio-loss target statistics must be masked means over mask-valid positions only, not full-padded-tensor means
decisions.note: Normalization denominator must be the mask-valid count - a T08 specified-factor obligation.
idempotency aliased to determinism; evidently the same CPUAdam subgroup bias-correction incident as D-005/D-023 (multiplicative vs pow branch), counted once per §4.1 - support unchanged.
Jitter-before-gating is a code-order property; extractor reports no crisp runtime observable (none_runtime), so no shared witness with T10 (§3.4).
Init broadcasts must stay outside the autograd graph; object is autograd-graph structure of parameters, not gradient nonzeroness (T17) nor state clobbering (T23) (§3.2).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: muP readout (output projection) must be zero-initialized; reset_parameters must skip generic normal init under use_mup
decisions.note: initialization_conformance aliased to value_scaling_consistency; zero-where-spec-prescribes-zero added as an explicit clause of T27's predicate (guard-level tightening, no relation change).

decisions.guard_extension: topology: PP>1; precondition: cross-PP-stage total grad norm must be the L2 reduction (sqrt of summed squares), not a sum of per-stage norms
decisions.note: Wrong cross-group reduction form of the global grad norm is T09's norm-fidelity object.
